Caramel Marshmallows
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 9:59am

Ingredients




1 can Sweetened condensed milk
1 pkt Caramels
1 stk margarine
1 pkt Marshmallows
1 cup Rice crispies

Preparation

1 Put milk, caramels and margarine in saucepan and melt. (I just love these directions, don't you?) Dip marshmallows in caramel mixture & roll in crispies, put on waxed paper and cool. Put in covered container in fridge. 2 Charlene Z. 3 /MISC
